Our Approach

CUT. CLEARED. HAULED.

Tree companies want the big removals. We stay in the small-tree and brush niche we're built for — chainsaw work done carefully, yards cleared completely, everything hauled the same day.

Teen-founded, college-operated. If your job is bigger than what we safely handle, we'll say so up front and point you to a licensed arborist instead of winging it.

✦Every log and branch hauled off — no curb piles left behind
✦Stump-height cuts included — clean, low, mow-over ready
✦Honest scope — small trees only, and we'll tell you straight
✦Pairs with our yard work — bark, cleanup, full refresh after
